result.rationale: The gap lies in the proof of Prop 3.9: the construction of a directed system from a spanning tree is asserted to need no compatibility checks and used to invoke Lemma 3.6, but this justification is missing/incomplete, visible in both the proposition's proof text and the isolated proof step.

PROOF_STEP::1 identifies the exact gap: applying Lemma 3.6 (requires filtered/directed system) to a tree-indexed colimit which isn't directed, matching the annotated logical gap in Proposition 3.9's proof.
